calendar_event_exceptions_override_check.name: calendar_event_exceptions_override_check
calendar_event_exceptions_override_check.value:
case when "calendar_event_exceptions"."kind" = 'cancelled'
        then "calendar_event_exceptions"."title" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."description" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."location" is null
          and "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_at" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_at" is null
          and "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_date" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_date" is null
          and "calendar_event_exceptions"."goal_id" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."life_area_id" is null
        else "calendar_event_exceptions"."title" is not null and case when "calendar_event_exceptions"."original_start_at" is not null
          then "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_at" is not null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_at" is not null
            and "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_date" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_date" is null
          else "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_date" is not null
            and "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_at" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_at" is null
          end
        end

calendar_event_exceptions_end_check.name: calendar_event_exceptions_end_check
calendar_event_exceptions_end_check.value:
("calendar_event_exceptions"."start_at" is null or "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_at" > "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_at")
        and ("calendar_event_exceptions"."start_date" is null or "calendar_event_exceptions"."end_date" > "calendar_event_exceptions"."start_date")

calendar_events_shape_check.name: calendar_events_shape_check
calendar_events_shape_check.value:
case when "calendar_events"."all_day"
        then "calendar_events"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_events"."end_date" is not null
          and "calendar_events"."start_at" is null and "calendar_events"."end_at" is null and "calendar_events"."tz" is null
        else "calendar_events"."start_at" is not null and "calendar_events"."end_at" is not null and "calendar_events"."tz" is not null
          and "calendar_events"."start_date" is null and "calendar_events"."end_date" is null
        end

calendar_events_location_length_check.name: calendar_events_location_length_check
calendar_events_location_length_check.value: "calendar_events"."location" is null or char_length("calendar_events"."location") between 1 and 200

calendar_events_rrule_length_check.name: calendar_events_rrule_length_check
calendar_events_rrule_length_check.value: "calendar_events"."rrule" is null or char_length("calendar_events"."rrule") between 1 and 200

goals_date_order_check.name: goals_date_order_check
goals_date_order_check.value: "goals"."start_date" is null or "goals"."target_date" is null or "goals"."target_date" >= "goals"."start_date"

goals_completed_at_check.name: goals_completed_at_check
goals_completed_at_check.value: ("goals"."status" <> 'completed' or "goals"."completed_at" is not null) and ("goals"."completed_at" is null or "goals"."status" in ('completed', 'archived'))

goals_description_length_check.name: goals_description_length_check
goals_description_length_check.value: "goals"."description" is null or char_length("goals"."description") between 1 and 2000

goals_reason_length_check.name: goals_reason_length_check
goals_reason_length_check.value: "goals"."reason" is null or char_length("goals"."reason") between 1 and 2000

habit_logs_note_length_check.name: habit_logs_note_length_check
habit_logs_note_length_check.value: "habit_logs"."note" is null or char_length("habit_logs"."note") between 1 and 2000

habit_schedules_cadence_config_check.name: habit_schedules_cadence_config_check
habit_schedules_cadence_config_check.value:
coalesce(case "habit_schedules"."cadence_type"
        when 'daily' then "habit_schedules"."cadence_config" = '{}'::jsonb
        when 'weekly_days' then jsonb_typeof("habit_schedules"."cadence_config" -> 'days') = 'array'
          and "habit_schedules"."cadence_config" - 'days' = '{}'::jsonb
        when 'times_per_week' then jsonb_typeof("habit_schedules"."cadence_config" -> 'timesPerWeek') = 'number'
          and "habit_schedules"."cadence_config" - 'timesPerWeek' = '{}'::jsonb
        else true end, false)

habits_description_length_check.name: habits_description_length_check
habits_description_length_check.value: "habits"."description" is null or char_length("habits"."description") between 1 and 2000

habits_unit_length_check.name: habits_unit_length_check
habits_unit_length_check.value: "habits"."unit" is null or char_length("habits"."unit") between 1 and 30

life_areas_description_length_check.name: life_areas_description_length_check
life_areas_description_length_check.value: "life_areas"."description" is null or char_length("life_areas"."description") between 1 and 500

milestones_description_length_check.name: milestones_description_length_check
milestones_description_length_check.value: "milestones"."description" is null or char_length("milestones"."description") between 1 and 2000

user_preferences_quiet_hours_check.name: user_preferences_quiet_hours_check
user_preferences_quiet_hours_check.value:
("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start" is null and "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end" is null)
        or ("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
          and "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
          and "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start" <> "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end")

reminders_link_check.name: reminders_link_check
reminders_link_check.value:
case "reminders"."kind"
        when 'task_deadline' then "reminders"."task_id" is not null and "reminders"."event_id" is null
          and "reminders"."occurrence_start" is null
        when 'event' then "reminders"."event_id" is not null and "reminders"."task_id" is null
        else "reminders"."task_id" is null and "reminders"."event_id" is null
          and "reminders"."occurrence_start" is null
        end

reminders_skip_reason_check.name: reminders_skip_reason_check
reminders_skip_reason_check.value:
case when "reminders"."status" = 'skipped'
        then "reminders"."skip_reason" is not null and "reminders"."skip_reason" in ('stale', 'disabled', 'no_device')
        else "reminders"."skip_reason" is null
        end

tasks_notes_length_check.name: tasks_notes_length_check
tasks_notes_length_check.value: "tasks"."notes" is null or char_length("tasks"."notes") between 1 and 2000

time_block_exceptions_override_check.name: time_block_exceptions_override_check
time_block_exceptions_override_check.value:
case when "time_block_exceptions"."kind" = 'cancelled'
        then "time_block_exceptions"."start_at" is null and "time_block_exceptions"."end_at" is null and "time_block_exceptions"."status" is null
        else "time_block_exceptions"."start_at" is not null and "time_block_exceptions"."end_at" is not null and "time_block_exceptions"."status" is not null
        end

time_blocks_rrule_length_check.name: time_blocks_rrule_length_check
time_blocks_rrule_length_check.value: "time_blocks"."rrule" is null or char_length("time_blocks"."rrule") between 1 and 200
